about: Learn about our mission, vision, and the team behind UAEMUNA

Empowering future diplomats and global leaders through the art of diplomacy and international cooperation. We support Model United Nations conferences across the UAE by providing professional photography, volunteer coordination, and world-class event logistics.

To become the leading support organization for MUN conferences in the UAE, fostering a community of young diplomats committed to international cooperation and understanding. We believe in the transformative power of dialogue and negotiation.

Our three founders share a passion for diplomacy, international cooperation, and supporting the next generation of global leaders. Together, they founded UAEMUNA to provide comprehensive support to Model United Nations conferences across the UAE, combining their expertise in event management, volunteer coordination, and professional photography.
We are committed to delivering excellence in every aspect of our work, from photography to logistics.
We operate with honesty, transparency, and strong ethical principles in all our dealings.
We believe in the power of teamwork and collaboration to achieve shared goals.
We are dedicated to empowering future diplomats and global leaders through our support.
services: Comprehensive support for Model United Nations conferences

We provide professional-grade photography and videography services to capture the essence of your MUN conference. Our experienced photographers understand the dynamics of diplomatic events and know how to capture key moments that showcase your conference's success.
✓ Professional event photography throughout the conference
✓ Digital delivery of all media files
Managing volunteers is critical to conference success. We handle recruitment, training, scheduling, and coordination of dedicated volunteers to ensure smooth operations throughout your event.

From venue setup to day-of coordination, we handle the logistics so you can focus on the diplomatic experience. Our team has extensive experience managing large-scale MUN conferences with hundreds of delegates.

faq.question: What services does UAEMUNA provide?
faq.answer: UAEMUNA provides professional photography, volunteer coordination, and comprehensive event logistics support for Model United Nations conferences across the UAE.

faq.question: How do I request UAEMUNA's services?
faq.answer: You can contact us via email at uaemodeluna@gmail.com or through our contact form. Our team will respond within 24 hours to discuss your conference needs.

faq.question: Do you cover all conferences in the UAE?
faq.answer: Yes, UAEMUNA supports MUN conferences throughout the United Arab Emirates. We work with schools, universities, and independent organizations.

faq.question: What is your pricing structure?
faq.answer: Our pricing varies based on conference size, duration, and specific services required. Please contact us for a customized quote for your event.

faq.question: How far in advance should we book your services?
faq.answer: We recommend booking at least 4-6 weeks in advance to ensure availability and proper planning. However, we can accommodate rush requests based on our schedule.

faq.question: Can UAEMUNA provide custom packages?
faq.answer: Absolutely! We tailor our services to meet your specific conference needs. Contact us to discuss a customized package for your event.

faq.question: Do you provide post-event services?
faq.answer: Yes, we offer photo editing, video compilation, and event report preparation as part of our comprehensive support services.

faq.question: How can I stay updated on UAEMUNA news?
faq.answer: Subscribe to our newsletter on the home page, follow us on Instagram and TikTok @uaemuna, or check back regularly for updates.
